findings.title: Public WebSocket ledger stream requires authorization
findings.observation: wss://rpc.testnet.postfiat.org returns 401 on upgrade (443) and close 1006 on :6005; 0 ledger closes received. Same client receives closes from the XRPL public testnet WS.
findings.remediation: Publish the WS endpoint for anonymous ledger subscriptions (read-only, rate-limited), or document polling as the supported public pattern (30 s suffices for validated height; 3-5 s to track individual closes).

findings.title: Explorer health endpoint reports 'rippled unreachable' while the explorer works
findings.observation: GET /api/v1/health returns {"message":"rippled unreachable"} while /api/v1/metrics returns data and the homepage is HTTP 200.
findings.remediation: Fix the health check to use the same rippled connection as metrics, or return structured status distinguishing P2P-socket failure from metrics-path failure.

findings.title: Explorer metrics are cached/static, not live
findings.observation: /api/v1/metrics byte-identical across two fetches ~10 min apart while the ledger advanced ~200 ledgers.
findings.remediation: Serve live values (or a short TTL with a generatedAt timestamp), or document the endpoint as a cached snapshot with its refresh interval.

findings.title: Admin RPC methods blocked at the public proxy (no public UNL enumeration from the node)
findings.observation: validators and peers JSON-RPC methods return HTTP 403 Forbidden from rpc.testnet.postfiat.org.
findings.remediation: Publish a read-only, rate-limited UNL endpoint, or document the VHS API as the canonical public UNL source.

findings.title: 12 of 66 validators run pre-1.0.9 versions
findings.observation: Versions 1.0.9 (59 nodes), 1.0.4 (9), 1.0.0 (2), 1.0.8 (1). All 25 UNL members run 1.0.9; the 12 lagging validators are all non-UNL.
findings.remediation: Gate UNL admission on the current release and publish the version distribution in the VHS API summary.

findings.title: P2P topology concentrates on three Atlanta hub nodes
findings.observation: Three Atlanta nodes carry 46-47 inbound peers each (140 of 730 inbound edges, ~19%); top three countries hold 38 of 71 nodes.
findings.remediation: Track hub concentration as a standing VHS metric and compare registry composition against the launch-topology proposal caps.

findings.title: 9 of 66 validators publish no domain; operator identity is domain-only
findings.observation: 57/66 validators publish a domain, 55 verified; 9 publish none, 2 unverified.
findings.remediation: Require a verified domain for UNL admission (all 25 current UNL members already have one) and publish the verification method.

findings.title: Single-organization administration vs a community-domain UNL
findings.observation: Whitepaper: 'one organization administers the current validator fleet'; independently operated validators remain a proposal. Live UNL: 25 seats on 25 distinct community/operator domains; the 3 postfiat.org-domain validators are all non-UNL.
findings.remediation: Publish operator-identity evidence (control-group checks, hosting/ASN diversity) so the independence claim becomes checkable.

findings.title: VHS topology summary link_count: 0 contradicts its own node records
findings.observation: /v1/network/topology reports link_count 0 while its node records sum to 730 inbound and 730 outbound edges.
findings.remediation: Fix the summary to sum the node records, or drop the field. Consumers should sum per-node counts until then.

findings.title: Ledger retention window is ~51k ledgers on the probed node
findings.observation: complete_ledgers 7,950,054-8,001,412 at the end of the cadence run (~43 hours at 3 s per ledger).
findings.remediation: Document the retention window on the RPC endpoint and point archive queries at the VHS service.

findings.title: Task Node request switch and directory can diverge
findings.observation: Anonymous GET /api/tasks reports networkRequestEnabled false while GET /api/directory/rewarded-tasks still serves a 100-item network-task directory.
findings.remediation: Agents should read /api/tasks (live) for request eligibility and treat the directory as a historical record.

findings.title: Fee burn directly observed and matches the whitepaper
findings.observation: total_coins fell 60 drops in 31 s between two ledger headers 11 ledgers apart - 10 drops per ledger, the base fee.

findings.title: One node's peer count (21) is not the network size (71)
findings.observation: Probed node reports peers 21 (constant across 21 samples) while the VHS crawler sees 71 nodes.
findings.remediation: Always pair a node's peers figure with the VHS topology count and label which one is quoted.
